name: fix104_focus_los
verifies: fix-104: the focus needs a free line of sight as in G3 (gCFocus_PS::FocusCheck -> eCEntity::IsFreeLOS: a ray from 3/4 up the hero's box to 3/4 up the target's, both excluded). Hero upstairs on a floor over an orc -> no normal focus (no talk) and no combat focus; a wall between them -> no focus; down beside the orc -> focus again. An item behind a wall is not focused either.
notes: Test geometry (losfloor / loswall) is plain solid cubes; it goes with losclear and at the scenario's end. In the owner's report the hero stood on the upper floor of a house and could talk to an orc below / behind a wall.
